source_visual_observations: CircleO with diameterAB extendedtoE, secantE-D-C, chordBC; E16°; AB=2DE.
audit.independent_solution: AB=2DE and AB=2OD imply OD=DE. TriangleODE is isosceles with E=16°, so EOD=16° and ODE=148°. Because D,E,C are collinear, ODC=32°. OC=OD gives DOC=116°. Hence BOC=116+16=132° and AOC=48°. Inscribed angleABC=24°, choice B.
